question: How many female members have held the position of Lok Sabha Speaker until August 2021?
solution: The correct answer is__** Two**__. [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** • ** Female Speakers of Lok Sabha**: • The** 15th** and **16th** Speakers of the Lok Sabha were **women**. • They are** Meira Kumar **from **Indian National Congress **and** Sumitra Mahajan** from **Bharatiya Janata Party **respectively.
